latest_amendment.note: Amendment No. 2 added the pricing terms (shares offered + price per share) absent from the original S-1.

ipo.mandatory_use: Net proceeds must repay $20B SpaceX Bridge Loan (matures Sept 2, 2027).

index_outlook.disclaimer: Not from the prospectus. Index inclusion follows each provider's methodology, not the IPO calendar — figures below are our analysis as of August 2026.

nasdaq_100.detail: Confirmed. Nasdaq added SPCX under the 'Fast Entry' rule (effective May 1, 2026), which admits a new listing ranking in the top ~40 constituents by total market value after 15 trading days — exactly 15 trading days after the June 12 debut. No constituent was removed; the index temporarily carries more than 100 names.

sp_500.detail: S&P 500 requires positive GAAP net income in the latest quarter and across the trailing four quarters; SpaceX is still loss-making — -$4.9B (FY2025), -$4.3B (Q1 2026), -$541M (Q2 2026, per the first 10-Q) — though the loss is narrowing. Public float (~5% after the over-allotment) also remains below the ~10% minimum. Multi-class shares are not a blocker (ban lifted 2023). Entry is conditional on fundamentals, not timing.

expected_timeline.source: IPO factsheet / international offer timetables (FWPs filed June 4, 2026)

global_offerings.detail: UK Retail Offer via Marex Financial public-offer platform (launched June 4, 2026).
Japanese securities registration with the Kanto Local Finance Bureau (June 5, 2026).
Australian prospectus (Australian-law wrap + U.S. preliminary prospectus), June 4, 2026.
Second amended & restated preliminary base PREP prospectus, June 3, 2026.

post_ipo.disclaimer: Not from the S-1 — post-IPO facts from SpaceX's subsequent SEC filings (8-Ks, first 10-Q), as of September 16, 2026.

ipo_closing.note: Underwriters exercised the over-allotment in full: 638.9M shares sold vs the 555.6M base offering.

bond.purpose: Inaugural investment-grade senior notes; net proceeds repaid the $20B SpaceX Bridge Loan in full, remainder for general corporate purposes.

lockup.note: Per the final prospectus (424B4, June 12, 2026), 'Underwriting — Lock-up Agreements'. Three tiers; the standard tier has automatic early releases.

tranches.trigger: 2nd full trading day after Q2 2026 results (released Aug 4)

standard_180_day.after_q3_results: +28% on the 2nd full trading day after Q3 2026 results (no fixed date; ~Nov 2026)

price_trigger.detail: An additional 10% would have released with the first tranche if the stock had closed ≥30% above the $135 IPO price ($175.50) on 5 of the 10 trading days ending Aug 4, 2026.
price_trigger.note_as_of_2026_08_09: Not met — closes in that window ran $108-125.

extended.expiry: 2nd full trading day after Q2 2027 results (~Aug 2027)
extended.early_releases: Staged from Q1 2027: 20% after Q4 2026 results; +10% on Mar 18, 2027; further tranches after Q1 2027 results; full release after Q2 2027 results.

founder.early_release: None — Musk's shares have no early-release provisions.

flight_12.summary: Starship V3 debut from the new Starbase pad — precision landing of the upper stage; deployed modified V2 Starlink satellites. (Booster lost before its boost-back burn, per press reports.)

flight_13.summary: All flight objectives achieved — deployed 20 production V3 Starlink satellites, demonstrated in-space Raptor relight, softest-ever splashdown with an intact heatshield.

cursor_acquisition.note: Per 8-K Items 2.01/3.02 (Aug 14, 2026): Cursor common/preferred converted into 389,289,254 Class A shares; vested Cursor RSUs converted into 1,752,426 Class A shares (prior to tax withholding). Unvested awards assumed as ~29,128,326 Company RSUs and ~44,365,047 options (not counted as outstanding). Approx outstanding = S-1/A No. 2 total (12,520,309,620) + 391,041,680 = 12,911,351,300 (~12.91B).
